description: This file defines a metrics registry for gRPC, including metric descriptors, handles, registration functions, and testing utilities.

classes.name: MetricDescriptor
classes.description: Data structure representing a registered metric, including name, description, unit, labels, type, and bounds.

classes.name: Int64CountHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for an int64 count metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Int64UpDownCountHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for an int64 up-down counter metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Float64CountHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for a float64 count metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Int64HistoHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for an int64 histogram metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Float64HistoHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for a float64 histogram metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Int64GaugeHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for an int64 gauge metric, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

classes.name: Int64AsyncGaugeHandle
classes.description: Typed handle for an int64 asynchronous gauge metric, implementing AsyncMetric interface, with methods for descriptor retrieval and recording.

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the MetricDescriptor associated with the handle.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a metric value using the provided recorder and labels.

methods.name: isAsync
methods.description: Marker method to implement AsyncMetric interface.
